army_rules.name: The Sons of Sanguinius
army_rules.rules_text: If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. For example, Lemartes has both the Adeptus Astartes and Blood Angels Faction keywords, and is therefore from the Blood Angels Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

chapter_rules.name: The Sons of Sanguinius
chapter_rules.rules_text: Blood Angels armies cannot include Adeptus Astartes units drawn from more than one Chapter.

detachments.name: Liberator Assault Group

rule.name: Red Thirst
rule.rules_text: Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to fight, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Speed of the Primarch
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Rage-fuelled Warrior
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer's melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 3] ability.

enhancements.name: Icon of the Angel
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit is selected to Fall Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.name: Gift of Foresight
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle round, just after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for the bearer, you can treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

stratagems.name: Angelic Grace
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army has a mortal wound allocated to it.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Savage Echoes
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was just charged by an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Select either the Strength or Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Red Rampage
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select either the [LANCE] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst if it does, then it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Onslaught
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army has Advanced.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge, even though it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even though it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge even though it Fell Back. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even though it Fell Back.

detachments.name: The Lost Brethren

rule.name: A Noble Death in Combat
rule.rules_text: Each time a DEATH COMPANY model from your army makes a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 if that model's unit is below its Starting Strength; if that model's unit is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

keywords: If you select this Detachment, DEATH COMPANY MARINES and DEATH COMPANY MARINES WITH BOLT RIFLES units from your army have the BATTLELINE keyword.
restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Sanguinius' Grace
enhancements.rules_text: DEATH COMPANY model only. Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, the bearer can fight one additional time.

enhancements.name: Blood Shard
enhancements.rules_text: DEATH COMPANY model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6; on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: To Slay the Warmaster
enhancements.rules_text: DEATH COMPANY model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy CHARACTER units, you can select one of those CHARACTER units and roll six D6; for each 4+, one CHARACTER model in that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.name: Vengeful Onslaught
enhancements.rules_text: DEATH COMPANY model only. If the bearer is destroyed, until the end of your next turn, each time a friendly DEATH COMPANY model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Glorious Sacrifice
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATH COMPANY unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Final Retribution
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATH COMPANY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly CHAPLAIN models; on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Furious Onslaught
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATH COMPANY unit from your army, just before that unit Piles-in.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3". If your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly CHAPLAIN models, or if it is below Starting Strength, it can move up to 6" instead. In either case, it can only do so provided your unit ends that Pile-in move in Unit Coherency and within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Lost to Rage
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATH COMPANY unit from your army that is below Starting Strength and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks, Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and, unless your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly CHAPLAIN models, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.name: Wrathful Rampage
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a DEATH COMPANY unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That DEATH COMPANY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly CHAPLAIN models, or it is below its Starting Strength, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

detachments.name: The Angelic Host

rule.name: Upon Wings of Fire
rule.rules_text:
At the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:

• Incursion: Up to 1 unit.
• Strike Force: Up to 2 units.
• Onslaught: Up to 3 units.

Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. In the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, set each of those units up using their Deep Strike ability.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Artisan of War
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of the bearer's weapons by 1 and the bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+.
restrictions: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only.

enhancements.name: Visage of Death
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.
restrictions: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only.

enhancements.name: Archangel's Shard
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [ANTI-CHAOS 5+] and [LANCE] abilities.
restrictions: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only.

enhancements.name: Gleaming Pinions
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
restrictions: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Ardour
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Angel's Sacrifice
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects its targets, it must select your unit as the target of all of its attacks.

stratagems.name: Martial Exemplars
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [PRECISION] abilities.

stratagems.name: Descent of Angels
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
restrictions: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: Death from the Skies
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

detachments.name: Angelic Inheritors

rule.name: Legacy of the Angel
rule.rules_text:
At the start of the first battle round, select two of the Angelic Legacy abilities listed below. Until the end of the battle, those Angelic Legacy abilities are active and their effects apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER units from your army.

• Sanguinary Grace: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
• Carmine Wrath: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
• Their Appointed Hour: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Prescient Flash
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Troubling Visions
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, in your Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. When it does, until the start of your next Command phase, all Angelic Legacy abilities are active for the bearer's unit, instead of only two of them.

enhancements.name: Blazing Icon
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Ordained Sacrifice
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase; on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Focused Fury
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a CHARACTER unit, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [LANCE] ability as well.

stratagems.name: Instant of Grace
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one non-CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the CHARACTER keyword.
restrictions: Designer's Note: While in effect, your model's unit is therefore a CHARACTER unit, meaning it can interact with the Legacy of the Angel Detachment rule, in addition to other rules that interact with CHARACTER units.

stratagems.name: Strike Now for Glory
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Great Wings
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: Unto the Burning Skies
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, unless it is THE SANGUINOR.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

detachments.name: Rage-cursed Onslaught

rule.name: Maddened Ferocity
rule.rules_text:
Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army makes a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to fight if that unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Battle-shocked, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit instead.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Carmine Reliquary
enhancements.rules_text: Chaplain model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability. Each time you take a Battle-shock test for an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll the result.

enhancements.name: Master of the Red Thirst
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Sanguinary Tear (Aura)
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Angel's Fang
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

stratagems.name: A Grim Warning
stratagems.timing: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One BLOOD ANGELS unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Insensate Rampage
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATH COMPANY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: Limb from Limb
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Select either the Strength or Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Deathless Duty
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One DEATH COMPANY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Red Wrath
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

detachments.name: Wrath of the Doomed

rule.name: Fanatical Celerity
rule.rules_text:
When a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is selected to make an advance move, you can use this ability. If you do:

• That unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
• That move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

restrictions: This detachment has the DOOMED tag and cannot be taken with another DOOMED detachment.
Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Instinctive Interception
enhancements.rules_text: DEATH COMPANY model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge
enhancements.rules_text: DEATH COMPANY model only. This model's melee attacks have +2 A.

stratagems.name: Death Begets Vengeance
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle. While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units' attacks that target that unit have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: No Barrier to Retribution
stratagems.timing: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to make a normal/advance/charge move.
stratagems.target: That DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Rage-fuelled Response
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit has shot.
stratagems.target: That DEATH COMPANY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

detachments.name: Encarmine Speartip

rule.name: Wrath of Angels
rule.rules_text: When a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to shoot or eligible to declare a charge.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Angelic Executioner
enhancements.rules_text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. When this unit is selected to fight, this unit's melee attacks have:

• [LETHAL HITS],
• or [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
restrictions: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only.

enhancements.name: Shadow of Abomination
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. Once per battle, per army. When this unit is selected to fight you can use this ability. If you do, this model's melee attacks have +1 D.
restrictions: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only.

stratagems.name: Judgement of the Golden Host
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit from your army ends a charge move.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Inexorable Valour
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a Fall Back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Blinding Blurs of Vengeance
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.target: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Stealth.

detachments.name: Legacy of Grace

rule.name: Legacy of the Angel
rule.rules_text:
Friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY CHARACTER units (excluding COMMANDER DANTE units) have +1 to Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

This detachment has the GRACE tag and cannot be taken with another GRACE detachment.

restrictions: Your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Blood Boil
enhancements.rules_text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only. This model's [PSYCHIC] attacks:

• Have [ANTI NON-MONSTER/VEHICLE 5+].
• Can re-roll damage rolls.

enhancements.name: Aureole of the Angel
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has -3" detection range.

stratagems.name: Martial Paragon
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
